# Canonical /api/v1 engine paths the LoopRuntimeCloud dashboard (loopruntime-cloud/dashboard/src)
# consumes via the transparent /engine/* reverse proxy, normalized to template
# form ({} = any path param). The engine spec (api/openapi/engine.yaml) MUST cover
# every path here. Generated from `grep -rhoE '/engine/api/v1/...' dashboard/src`
# then normalized; kept in sync by the drift guard in dashboard_consumer_test.go.
#
# M10 T2.1: the dashboard — NOT the loopruntime-cloud Go BFF — is the real consumer of
# the engine REST contract, because the BFF is a transparent proxy (cmd/main.go
# r.Route("/engine", ...) strips the prefix and forwards). Cloud-side /v1/* routes
# (e.g. /v1/integrations/github/install OAuth) are NOT engine paths and are excluded.
